# Padma Shri Wareppa Naba: Rituals to Mainstream

| runtime        = 27 minutes

Padma Shri Wareppa Naba: Rituals to Mainstream  is a 2023 Manipuri documentary film directed by Bobby Wahengbam. It showcases the exceptional journey of a visionary creative artist, director, and mentor who has successfully redefined traditional and ritualistic performing arts by making them relevant and contemporary while preserving their originality, raw aesthetics, and uniqueness. The film made its Mumbai Premiere at the Northeast Film Festival (NEFF) 2023. It also got official selection at the 29th Kolkata International Film Festival and was screened on the closing day (12 December 2023) under the Short and Documentary Panorama section.
